import json,hashlib,pathlib
import torch,cutlass,cutlass.cute as cute
import cuda.bindings.driver as cuda
from cutlass import Float32,Int32,Int64,Uint32,Uint8
from cutlass.cute.runtime import from_dlpack
from b12x._lib.intrinsics import quantize_block_fp8_mx,max_abs_32,fmax_f32,pow2_ceil_ue8m0_torch
class Quant:
 @cute.jit
 def __call__(self,x:cute.Tensor,y:cute.Tensor,s:cute.Tensor,blocks:Int32,stream:cuda.CUstream):
  self.kernel(x,y,s,blocks).launch(grid=(cute.ceil_div(blocks,128),1,1),block=(128,1,1),stream=stream)
 @cute.kernel
 def kernel(self,x:cute.Tensor,y:cute.Tensor,s:cute.Tensor,blocks:Int32):
  block=Int64(cute.arch.block_idx()[0])*Int64(128)+Int64(cute.arch.thread_idx()[0])
  if block<Int64(blocks):
   vals=cute.make_rmem_tensor((32,),Float32)
   for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(32):vals[j]=Float32(x[block*Int64(32)+Int64(j)])
   payload,scale=quantize_block_fp8_mx(vals,fmax_f32(max_abs_32(vals),Float32(1e-4)))
   for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(8):y[block*Int64(8)+Int64(j)]=payload[j]
   s[block]=Uint8(scale)
def tensor(x,dtype):
 t=from_dlpack(x,assumed_align=16);t.element_type=dtype;return t
# CPU construction ensures identical BF16 source values on RTX and Spark.
torch.manual_seed(419)
x=torch.randn(80,5120).to(torch.bfloat16)
x[0].zero_();x[1]*=1e-7;x[2]*=1e-4;x[3]*=300;x[4,::32]=448
# Include real captured model inputs.
real=torch.frombuffer(bytearray(pathlib.Path('/inputs/0-hidden.bin').read_bytes()),dtype=torch.bfloat16).reshape(80,5120)
source_path=pathlib.Path('/inputs/wire-source.bin')
if source_path.exists():
 x=torch.frombuffer(bytearray(source_path.read_bytes()),dtype=torch.bfloat16)
else:
 x=torch.cat([x,real]).contiguous().flatten()
 source_path.write_bytes(x.view(torch.uint8).numpy().tobytes())
source_hash=hashlib.sha256(source_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
x=x.cuda()
y=torch.empty(x.numel()//4,dtype=torch.int32,device='cuda');s=torch.empty(x.numel()//32,dtype=torch.uint8,device='cuda')
args=(tensor(x,cutlass.BFloat16),tensor(y,Uint32),tensor(s,Uint8))
stream=cuda.CUstream(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
f=cute.compile(Quant(),*args,Int32(x.numel()//32),stream)
records=[]
for rows in [1,16,80,160,1]:
 blocks=rows*160;y.fill_(-1);s.fill_(255);f(*args,Int32(blocks),stream)
 z=x[:rows*5120].float().reshape(-1,32)
 _,ref_s=pow2_ceil_ue8m0_torch(z.abs().amax(-1,keepdim=True).clamp_min(1e-4)*(1/448))
 inv=((254-ref_s.int()).clamp_min(0)<<23).view(torch.float32)
 ref_y=(z*inv).clamp(-448,448).to(torch.float8_e4m3fn).view(torch.uint8)
 torch.testing.assert_close(s[:blocks],ref_s.flatten().byte(),rtol=0,atol=0)
 torch.testing.assert_close(y[:blocks*8].view(torch.uint8),ref_y.flatten(),rtol=0,atol=0)
 assert (s[blocks:]==255).all() and (y[blocks*8:]==-1).all()
 raw=y[:blocks*8].view(torch.uint8).cpu().numpy().tobytes()+s[:blocks].cpu().numpy().tobytes()
 records.append({'rows':rows,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'bytes':len(raw)})
# Fixed compile, mutable source, graph replay; verify zero payload and floor scale.
x[:5120].fill_(1)
g=torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
side=torch.cuda.Stream();side.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
with torch.cuda.graph(g,stream=side):f(*args,Int32(160),cuda.CUstream(side.cuda_stream))
torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(side)
g.replay();torch.cuda.synchronize()
assert (y[:1280]!=0).all()
x[:5120].zero_();before=torch.cuda.memory_allocated();g.replay();torch.cuda.synchronize();assert torch.cuda.memory_allocated()==before
assert (y[:1280]==0).all() and (s[:160]==105).all()
print(json.dumps({'source_sha256':source_hash,'device':torch.cuda.get_device_name(),'capability':torch.cuda.get_device_capability(),'cases':records,'reference_bit_exact':True,'tail_poison_preserved':True,'changed_input_graph_and_stable_allocation':True}),flush=True)
